Method of Attack: Impersonating an Orange S.A. Android app to steal login credentials
Displaying fake phishing login forms overlaying real app login screens
Recording screen activity and microphone sound
Implementing SOCKS5 proxy for covert communication and package delivery
Sending, reading, deleting, and blocking SMS notifications
Scanning device for files of interest to exfiltrate
Locking device screen and displaying persistent ransom note
Submitting USSD code requests to query bank balances
Capturing GPS data and pedometer statistics
Monitoring active apps to mimic and perform overlay attacks
Stopping malicious functionality and removing malware from device
Tricking user into disabling Google Play Protect to gain full device access
Impacted Systems: US banks including Bank of America, U.S. Bank, Capital One, Chase, SunTrust, Wells Fargo
Attack Vector: Attempted submission to Google Play Store (rejected)
Indicators of Compromise: Fake Orange S.A. app package name: fr.orange.serviceapp
Use of Cloudflare to redirect network traffic through SSL
Fake system alerts to disable Google Play Protect
